nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template listing the environment variables required to run the backend, including server port, database connection string, JWT secret/expiry, password reset token expiry, and CORS/frontend URL settings.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Node/Express backend package manifest defining dependencies (Express, Prisma, AWS S3 SDK, bcrypt, JWT, Zod, Nodemailer), dev scripts, and the shared quality-check lint/format tooling.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the backend, controlling compilation target, module resolution, and included source paths.
